ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) region forms a wide, symmetrical anchor shape extending from the peduncle. High-intensity (white) contiguous areas dominate the lateral lobes. Distinct low-intensity (black) linear streaks and irregular blobs are present within the white fields, particularly along the distal margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped notch with a depth approximately 10-15% of the total vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration profile. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and deep valleys, particularly pronounced towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge boundary follows a convex curve from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a slight upward concavity towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized circular low-intensity clusters visible on the medial-distal white surfaces of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous thin, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the high-intensity fields of both lobes, primarily oriented horizontally or diagonally relative to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular contour and potential tissue loss at the distal tip of the right lobe. Brownish-orange pigmented patches are visible on the high-intensity field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique reddish-brown discoloration localized within the high-intensity pixels of the upper-medial right lobe surface.
